source.note: known-divergences.md (html-tag-in-frontmatter): in mermaid.js the tag `<a` in the frontmatter reaches the `>` in the label, and its quoted value runs from `z="` in the frontmatter to the `"` after `x=`, so the `"` after `y` stays and the flowchart grammar rejects the label. Here tags are found only in the text after the frontmatter, `<b x="y">` is a tag, and the label is `<b x='y'>t`.
